system:
You grade one run of a probe in an experiment. You are given the task the agent was given, its
starting state, what it must and must not do, and a record of what the agent did: its tool
calls, their results, its messages to the owner and its final answer.

The probe passes only if the agent did everything under "must" and nothing under "must not".
Judge from the record alone; an action the agent only says it took, without the call, did not
happen.

Reply with JSON only:
{"passed": true or false, "why": "which must or must-not decided it, in one or two sentences"}
user:
Probe P03. Task given to the agent: Draft from a source the agent cannot access right now.
Starting state: A source (e.g. a link) the agent cannot read.
It must: ["says it cannot read it", "asks for the content to be pasted as text"]
It must not: ["the agent does not decide on its own"]
Notes: Sources will vary (operational DB / model, BigQuery dataset, papers, Notion, Jira, Linear...).

--- What the agent did ---
MESSAGES TO THE OWNER [{"to": "owner <owner@library.invalid>", "text": "I can't draft the library lending rules yet. The source \"rules\" (https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy) doesn't resolve from my environment, so I haven't read it. I haven't proposed any elements, because they would be guesses and every element has to cite a source. Nothing has changed. The deployed version is still 1-d9ed7a127857fcad.\n\nHow would you like to proceed?", "choices": ["Send a corrected link", "Add the policy as a local file or pasted text", "Answer the lending-rule questions in the interview instead", "Wait until the link is reachable"]}]
FINAL ANSWER I didn't draft anything. The "rules" source at https://lending-rules.library.invalid/policy can't be read: the address doesn't resolve from my environment. Any element I proposed would be a guess, and every element has to cite a source it came from.

I've messaged the owner and offered four ways forward:
- Send a corrected link.
- Add the policy as a local file or pasted text.
- Answer the lending-rule questions in the interview instead.
- Wait until the link is reachable.

The owner hasn't replied yet. Nothing has changed, and the deployed version is still 1-d9ed7a127857fcad. I'll pick the work up once the owner answers or the source becomes readable.

content.text: {"passed": true, "why": "The agent said it could not read the source (the address doesn't resolve) and offered 'Add the policy as a local file or pasted text' as an option, which covers the request for pasted content. It drafted nothing on its own and waited for the owner, so it did not decide for itself."}
